academic.passage: Cultural diversity is an essential aspect of contemporary society. It enhances creativity and innovation by allowing different perspectives to merge. Moreover, it plays a vital role in maintaining historical legacies, promoting social cohesion among various communities. Recognizing and celebrating diverse cultural expressions can lead to greater understanding and tolerance. Various governments worldwide enact policies to protect and promote cultural diversity, ensuring that no single culture overshadows others.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.explain: 這段文字主要說明文化多樣性如何豐富社會。

questions.q: What role does cultural diversity play according to the passage?
questions.explain: 根據文章，文化多樣性增強了創造力。

questions.q: What can be inferred about governments' attitudes towards cultural diversity?
questions.explain: 文章指出，各國政府會制定政策來促進文化多樣性。

questions.q: What does the term 'social cohesion' mean in this context?
questions.explain: 社會凝聚力在這裡指的是社會內部的團結。

daily.passage: Attention students! The campus library will be closed for maintenance from October 15 to October 20. Please plan accordingly and return any borrowed books before this period. Thank you for your understanding.

questions.q: When will the library be closed?
questions.explain: 圖書館將在10月15日至20日關閉。

questions.q: What should students do with borrowed books?
questions.explain: 學生應在關閉之前歸還借出的書籍。
